title: fix(app-shell): flow header meta pills ellipsize instead of clipping mid-word
body:
Fixes #13135
Clause-②: no

## What

The Studio flow header's meta ("Trigger: … · Status: … · Run as: …") was cut mid-word at the slot's edge ("Status: Unpublis") with no ellipsis and no tooltip. Each header item now shortens with an ellipsis, and a shortened item names its whole `Label: value` on hover, followed by the hover text it already had (the run status's reason, the trigger object's name).

Ruling 1 choice: **truncate, not wrap.** The row stays on one line, so the header keeps its height (measured below: 27px row before and after, narrow and wide).

## Why the old row clipped bare

The header variant was an `inline-flex` row of `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` pills inside the header's meta slot (`min-w-0 truncate`). A flex row's minimum width is the sum of its items' text, so the row (and the `inline-flex min-w-0` wrapper Studio puts around it) sized itself to its full text and the slot's `overflow: hidden` cut it like a picture. `text-overflow: ellipsis` cannot ellipsize inside an atomic inline box, hence no marker.

Measured in Chromium (static reproduction with the real class semantics, 620px row): making the pills `truncate` while the row stays flex changes nothing (slot scrollWidth/clientWidth 459/360, every pill uncut). Only a row whose own minimum width is near zero fits the slot without touching the Studio wrapper. So the header variant is now a one-row grid with `minmax(0, max-content)` columns: slot 360/360, Trigger and Status ellipsized (180/114, 135/114), "Run as: User" whole. At 1100px everything is whole (slot 840/840). Making the Studio wrapper `max-w-full` would also work, but that file is outside this card's surface.

## Hover text

A pill measures whether it is cut (scrollWidth over clientWidth, on every render and on resize), the way the Studio header's title does for objectui#12897. Only while cut does its `title` gain the `Label: value` line, so an uncut pill keeps exactly the title it had and the existing header pins that read `title` equal to the reason stay green. The designer's info bar (`bar`) is not measured and is unchanged.
